key: ["The Pratiharas, the Palas and the Rashtrakutas fight over Kannauj, and none of them holds the north for good. In the south the Cholas take northern Sri Lanka and send a fleet against Srivijaya. Raiders come from Ghazni. After Tarain in 1192, Ghurid commanders take Delhi, and a sultanate rises there that will pass through five dynasties. It reaches further south than any northern state before it, and loses that south within a generation. Then, in 1398, Timur comes.", "sarvam:varun_en_suspense@en-IN", "+6%", "+0Hz", null, 1.0, 0.0, "v3"]
